title: The Password
subtitle: A stage, and no arrow
description: This quest does not depend on the shopping list -- there is no arrow
between them -- and it still cannot be finished until that quest's
reward has been collected, because its task asks for the stage
That is the difference a condition makes. A dependency gates the team:
everyone waits together. A condition is asked of one player, and a
member of the same party who never collected the reward does not have
the flag and cannot press the button, however far the party has got.
`/tasked stage add @s condition_gallery:password` grants the same flag,
which is what a pack does when the story lives in a command.
